name: MonarchAiAgentPicker
title: AiAgentPicker
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.selection.selectableGroup of androidx.compose.foundation.selection.selectable rows, each a compact MonarchAiAgentCard with an androidx.compose.material3.RadioButton mark
summary: Chooses one AI agent from compact agent cards that show what each agent is for, what it can do and how many tools it has.
whenToUse: Starting a conversation or a task with one of a few agents, or setting the default agent of a space, when people should see what each agent does before choosing.
whenNotToUse: To choose a model rather than an agent, use MonarchAiModelPicker. For dozens of agents that need search, use MonarchCombobox with the agent names. For several agents at once, use checkbox rows.
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchAiAgentPicker(agents: List<MonarchAiAgentPickerOption>, selected: String?, onSelect: (String) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, layout: MonarchAiAgentPickerLayout = MonarchAiAgentPickerLayout.List, enabled: Boolean = true, labels: MonarchAiAgentPickerLabels = MonarchAiAgentPickerLabels())

class MonarchAiAgentPickerOption(agent: MonarchAiAgentRef, description: String? = null, capabilities: List<String> = emptyList(), tools: List<MonarchAiAgentTool> = emptyList(), state: MonarchAiAgentState = MonarchAiAgentState.Idle, image: Painter? = null, enabled: Boolean = true) { val key: String }
class MonarchAiAgentPickerLabels(label: String? = null, empty: String? = null)

options.name: agents
options.description: The agents in display order: the agent, a description, capabilities, tools, its state, its picture loaded by the app, and whether it can be chosen.

options.name: selected
options.description: The chosen agent's key (agent.id, or agent.name without an id), or null for none.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Called with the key of the agent the person chooses. Not called for the chosen agent or an agent that cannot be chosen.

options.name: layout
options.description: One agent per row, or two columns on windows at least 640dp wide below font scale 1.5.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether any agent can be chosen.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the group name ("Choose an agent") and the empty message.

states.name: chosen
states.description: The chosen card has a 2dp AI accent border and its radio mark is filled.

states.name: not chosen
states.description: The card has its usual border and an empty radio mark.

states.name: unavailable
states.description: An option with enabled = false, or every option when the picker is disabled: the radio mark is disabled and the row is read as disabled; the card stays readable.

states.name: empty
states.description: With no agents, "No agents are available." in the muted text role.

appearance: Each option is the compact MonarchAiAgentCard (surface fill, default border, large radius) followed by the Material 3 radio mark. The chosen card is outlined with the AI solid role; the empty message uses the muted text role. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow from the theme roles.
platformNotes: The web's AiAgentPicker is a radiogroup with roving focus and arrow keys; on Android each option is a selectable row inside selectableGroup, so TalkBack reads each as a radio button with its position, and a hardware keyboard moves with Tab. The web tints the chosen card with the AI subtle fill and puts a check in its corner; MonarchAiAgentCard has no fill option, so on Android the chosen card gets the AI accent border and the Material 3 radio mark sits after the card. The web dims an unavailable card with opacity; Monarch does not dim with alpha, so it is shown by the disabled radio mark and TalkBack's disabled state. The web's onChange also passes the option; on Android onSelect passes the key and the app looks the option up. The picture of an agent is a Painter the app loads. iOS has not built this component yet.
accessibility: Each agent is one TalkBack element with the radio button role: the agent's name and role line, its description, capabilities and tool count, and whether it is selected.
The group is named "Choose an agent".
An agent that cannot be chosen is read as disabled and does not react to a tap.
Each row is at least 48dp tall, so the whole card is the touch target.
The choice is shown by a filled radio mark and a heavier border, not by color alone.
In right to left the card is at the right and the mark at the left; text wraps at font scale 2.0.
edgeCases: Agents without an id use their name as the key: keep names unique or give ids.
A selected key that matches no agent shows nothing chosen.
Choosing the chosen agent again does not call onSelect.
The grid falls back to one column on phones and at large font scales.
Many agents: the picker is a plain column; put it in a scrolling screen, not in a lazy list.

examples.title: List
examples.template:
@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchAiAgentPicker(
    agents = listOf(
        MonarchAiAgentPickerOption(
            agent = MonarchAiAgentRef(name = {{agents.0.name}}, id = {{agents.0.id}}, role = {{agents.0.role}}),
            description = {{agents.0.description}},
            capabilities = listOf({{agents.0.capabilities.0}}, {{agents.0.capabilities.1}}),
            tools = listOf(MonarchAiAgentTool({{agents.0.tools.0}}), MonarchAiAgentTool({{agents.0.tools.1}})),
        ),
        MonarchAiAgentPickerOption(
            agent = MonarchAiAgentRef(name = {{agents.1.name}}, id = {{agents.1.id}}, role = {{agents.1.role}}),
            description = {{agents.1.description}},
            capabilities = listOf({{agents.1.capabilities.0}}, {{agents.1.capabilities.1}}),
            tools = listOf(MonarchAiAgentTool({{agents.1.tools.0}})),
            state = MonarchAiAgentState.{{agents.1.state|pascal}},
        ),
        MonarchAiAgentPickerOption(
            agent = MonarchAiAgentRef(name = {{agents.2.name}}, id = {{agents.2.id}}, role = {{agents.2.role}}),
            description = {{agents.2.description}},
            enabled = !{{agents.2.disabled}},
        ),
    ),
    selected = agent,
    onSelect = { agent = it },
)
examples.code:
@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchAiAgentPicker(
    agents = listOf(
        MonarchAiAgentPickerOption(
            agent = MonarchAiAgentRef(name = "Research agent", id = "research", role = "Finds and summarises sources"),
            description = "Reads documents in this space and answers with citations.",
            capabilities = listOf("Summarises", "Cites sources"),
            tools = listOf(MonarchAiAgentTool("Search documents"), MonarchAiAgentTool("Read file")),
        ),
        MonarchAiAgentPickerOption(
            agent = MonarchAiAgentRef(name = "Writing agent", id = "writer", role = "Drafts and edits text"),
            description = "Drafts replies and tightens wording in the tone you choose.",
            capabilities = listOf("Drafts", "Rewrites"),
            tools = listOf(MonarchAiAgentTool("Insert text")),
            state = MonarchAiAgentState.Working,
        ),
        MonarchAiAgentPickerOption(
            agent = MonarchAiAgentRef(name = "Scheduling agent", id = "scheduler", role = "Plans meetings"),
            description = "Finds times that work and drafts invitations. Not enabled in this space.",
            enabled = !true,
        ),
    ),
    selected = agent,
    onSelect = { agent = it },
)
